{{Quote|The Republic recognizes the tragedy of war, but there is nothing we can change that has already occurred.''"<br />"''Say it aloud before this gathering&mdash;as representative for Chancellor Palpatine that ''you'' declare, without reservation, the Separatist state ''legitimate''.|Senators Padmé Amidala and Voe Atell|<ref name="AFIN" />}}
A '''peace conference''' took place around the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the neutral [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] between representatives of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in an effort to end the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict. The conference was presided over by [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] within her [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|royal palace]] in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. At the beginning of the meeting, [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] opened up the discussions, leading the Republic senators in the peace negotiations, but she was quickly rebuffed by Senator [[Voe Atell/Legends|Voe Atell]], who called for the Republic to declare the Separatist Alliance legitimate. However, before the delegates could further discuss their terms of peace, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], son of the late [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]], interrupted the summit. He announced to the [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] that it was [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the Confederacy, that had his mother murdered. This led young Bonteri to soon afterward be escorted out by Separatist [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], allowing the discussion to continue. Shortly after his escape, however, the negotiations fell apart completely.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Members of the Senate, do you hear yourselves? More money, more clones, more war! Say nothing of fiscal responsibility, what about ''moral'' responsibility? Hasn't this war gone on long enough?|Amidala|<ref name="HOBS">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="A Friend in Need Date" /> the second year of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], there was a debate within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] over a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill]] to deregulate the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], a guild secretly allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] current enemy, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the Senate session, [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] argued that the Senate's concern should not be continuing the war, but instead ending it peacefully&mdash;through possible negotiations with the Separatists. Her urging for peace, however, was met with rebukes from senators like [[Mot-Not Rab/Legends|Mot-Not Rab]], who insisted that the war should continue and he called for an immediate vote on the financial reform bill. Nonetheless, unsettled disputes over the issue caused the voting of the bill to be postponed.<ref name="HOBS" />

Following the first deregulation bill session, Amidala devised a plan on how to meet her old mentor [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]],<ref name="HOBS" /> Senator of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]],<ref name="Mina">{{SWE|characters|minabonteri|Mina Bonteri}}</ref> and how to bypass a [[Republic Senate non-communication law/Legends|Republic law]] that prevented Republic senators from communicating with Separatist politicians. Through the help of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Amidala planned to use Tano's status as a Jedi&mdash;and her special clearance&mdash;to go behind enemy lines and to meet with Bonteri on the Confederate [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus]]. After arriving at a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] within one of Raxus's [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus city|cities]], Amidala reunited with Bonteri and they left to Bonteri's lavish [[Bonteri house/Legends|estate]]. While both senators were discussing about the prospect of the ongoing war, Amidala was able to persuade her old friend that the Galactic Senate would be open to negotiations if the Separatist Congress were to extend the olive branch first for peace. Despite Bonteri's motion for a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace proposal]] with the Republic was approved by the Parliament,<ref name="HOBS" /> the approval was later revoked by Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], after claiming that Republic carried out a supposed [[Attack on Confederate people/Legends|attack]] against the Separatists, killing Bonteri in the process.<ref name="POP">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> In addition, the Senate declined the offer of peace talks with the Separatists following the [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|bombing]] of a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power generator]].<ref name="HOBS" />

==The conference==
{{Quote|I stand before you, son of Mina Bonteri, loyal Separatist, a patriot, friend&hellip; It has come to my attention, that my mother was ''murdered'' by Count Dooku in ''cold'' blood!|Lux Bonteri|<ref name="AFIN" />}}
The [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] process between the Confederacy and the Republic continued, with the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] chosen as neutral ground for the first ever sanctioned meeting between the two states.<ref name="AFIN" /> [[Separatist Congress Leader/Legends|Separatist Congress Leader]]<ref name="Lawise" /> [[Bec Lawise/Legends|Bec Lawise]], alongside Senator [[Voe Atell/Legends|Voe Atell]] and [[Amita Fonti/Legends|Amita Fonti]] made up the Separatist delegation for the peace conference, while the Republic representatives consisted of Senators Amidala, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]<ref name="AFIN" /> of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]<ref name="Mothma" /> and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]<ref name="AFIN" /> of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Organa" /> Lawise and his colleagues brought [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] for security purposes, and [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] were to serve as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] for the Republic delegation,<ref name="AFIN" /> although they were all required to be unarmed per [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] law.<ref name="Explore: AFIN">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep414|text="A Friend in Need" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

[[File:BecLawiseLetsContinue-AFIN.png|thumb|left|250px|Bec Lawise reopens the discussions after the arrest of Lux Bonteri.]]
Once all of the senators arrived at the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] within the New [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], Senator Amidala began the conference by opening the deliberations. Serving as representative for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="AFIN" /> and the leading senator for the Republic delegation,<ref name="Explore: AFIN" /> she stated that despite the tragedy of war, there was nothing that the Republic could do that would change everything that had already happened since the conflict's beginning. After her opening statement, Senator Atell quickly pushed for the Republic to confer political legitimacy on the Confederacy,<ref name="AFIN" /> a recurring issue since the latter's [[Raxus Address/Legends|birth]] as a separate state.<ref name="HOBS" /> Though Amidala and her party hesitated to meet Atell's demand, the talks were then interrupted by the uninvited arrival of [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]],<ref name="AFIN" /> who had succeeded his [[Parent/Legends|mother]], Mina, as the senator of Onderon<ref name="Bonteri" /> before recently resigning his Parliament seat. Kryze granted the young Bonteri permission to speak, much to Lawise's and Atell's chagrin. Taking to the podium, Bonteri accused Dooku of having his mother murdered, a claim that was immediately met with opposition from Lawise. The Separatist Congress Leader denounced Bonteri's remarks as lies and had the security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] arrest the young man. Once Bonteri had been removed from the room, Lawise apologized on the Separatists' behalf for the interruption and reopened the floor to discussion. Though protocol dictated that Bonteri's arrest was strictly a Confederacy affair, and the Republic could not intervene on his behalf, Amidala did allow Tano to discreetly follow. Despite the resuming of the conference, the negotiations broke down shortly thereafter,<ref name="AFIN" /> on account of shadowy interests on both sides.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mothma">{{SWE|characters|mon-mothma|Mon Mothma}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Ahsoka, Padmé just contacted me. She told me that the peace negotiations all but collapsed.|Anakin Skywalker to Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="AFIN" />}}
Though the negotiations were failing, Tano was able to rescue Bonteri aboard a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], where he was to be executed by commando [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on orders from Dooku. After fleeing the landing craft, they were pursued by the Separatist [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] across the city until they escaped aboard a Republic vessel, the [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)/Legends|''Phoenix'']], while the Senate Guards held off the droids.<ref name="AFIN" />

==Notable participants==
{{IncompleteList}}
===Voe Atell===
{{Quote|The Corporate Alliance will never allow this to happen!|Voe Atell, in response to Mina Bonteri's bill for peace|<ref name="HOBS" />}}
{{Main|Voe Atell/Legends}}
[[File:Voe_Atell.png|thumb|right|120px|Voe Atell]]
A senator affiliated with the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], Voe Atell spoke for the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] corporation in the Separatist Parliament. When Onderon's senatorial representative Mina Bonteri introduced a resolution that called for peaceful negotiations with the Republic, Atell rallied against her stance for peace, asserting that the Corporate Alliance would never support any such kind of diplomacy to end the war. One such fellow senator, [[Kerch Kushi/Legends|Kerch Kushi]], disputed her claim, stating that the Parliament was not ruled by the megacorporations, unlike that of the Galactic Senate. As per the [[Bylaws of Independent Systems/Legends|By-Laws of Independent Systems]], a voice vote for the matter, in which Atell voting nay against the bill for peace, however she along with others ultimately outvoted. Although she was initially staunchly opposed to diplomacy with the Republic,<ref name="HOBS" /> she later accepted afterward a place on the Separatist delegation at the first-ever peace conference between the CIS and the Republic, which was to take place on Mandalore. At these meetings, Atell pushed for recognition of the Confederacy's legitimacy. Naboo's Padmé Amidala, leading Republic delegate, was hesitant to meet her demands, and the discussions later collapsed.<ref name="AFIN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The conference made its first appearance in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[A Friend in Need]]." Though the episode briefly stated that the negotiations broke down,<ref name="AFIN" /> it wasn't until Mon Mothma's entry in the [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] that further explained that the meeting fell through due to obstructions from covert interests on both sides.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mothma" />
